live.title: Row with live metrics
live.body: See your rowing rate, pace, time, and heart rate update with every stroke.

track.title: Tuned to your stroke
track.body: A quick calibration teaches the app your rowing rhythm, so every stroke is counted accurately.

review.title: Save, review, share
review.body: Each row is saved as a FIT file, which you can share to Strava, Garmin and other training apps.
